summary: Iteration-2 focused retest of the 6 fixes from iteration_1 plus a general smoke. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_retest_iter2.py (6 tests: brute-force 429 + mongosh verification of a single email-keyed login_attempts doc, counter reset after successful login, purchase weighted-average cost + supplier preservation, supplier set when empty, no future-dated sales/movements, ventas_hoy coherence). Full suite now 46/46 PASS (was 39/40). Frontend: 4 Playwright runs on the public preview URL (desktop 1920 + mobile 390) covering login->dashboard, KPI Margen es-locale formatting on /dashboard and /finanzas, 'Ventas de hoy' today-scoped caption, AI assistant real streamed answer (no raw ** asterisks), mobile drawer navigation with unique -mobile testids and sr-only SheetTitle, productos CSV export, and a quick sale that decremented stock 73->72. ALL 6 previously reported bugs are confirmed FIXED. No 5xx in backend logs during the run. Only one residual LOW a11y console warning remains.

minor.issue: Carry-over (not part of this retest scope): stock validation and the $inc are still two non-atomic operations, so concurrent sales of the last unit can drive stock negative. Use a conditional update ({stock: {$gte: qty}} + $inc) and 400 on matched_count == 0.
Carry-over: dead key CORS_ORIGINS="*" still present and unused (server.py builds explicit origins from FRONTEND_URL with allow_credentials=True). Remove it.

ui_bugs.issue: Remaining console warning on modal/drawer open: 'Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent}'. The DialogTitle warning is GONE (sr-only SheetTitle works); only the description warning remains. Add aria-describedby={undefined} explicitly or a sr-only description.

action_items: Optional LOW: silence the Radix 'Missing Description / aria-describedby' warning on Sheet/Dialog content.
Optional carry-over: make sale/purchase stock updates atomic (conditional $inc) to prevent negative stock under concurrency.
Optional carry-over: delete the unused CORS_ORIGINS key from backend/.env.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_auth.py: brute-force key is now the normalized email and the counter is reset when locked_until has expired and deleted on successful login - verified in MongoDB (exactly ONE doc, identifier == email, count>=5, locked_until set).

routes_purchases.py: purchase_price is now a proper weighted average ((S*C + Q*C2)/(S+Q), verified 10@10 + 5@20 -> 13.33) and product.supplier is only set when previously empty - verified both branches.

seed.py ts(): today's rows are now generated as now() - random(2..480) minutes; no created_at later than now in /api/sales or /api/movements, and num_ventas_hoy matches the count of today's sales exactly.
Layout.jsx: mobile NavItems testids are suffixed -mobile, so nav-productos resolves to exactly 1 element even while the drawer is open; drawer navigation works.
AIAssistant.jsx renderMd(): real GPT 5.4-mini answer rendered with plain-text dashes, 0 literal '**' occurrences on screen.
format.js fmtPct uses toLocaleString('es') -> Margen renders '44,4%', consistent with '5060,94 US$' money formatting on both /dashboard and /finanzas.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of retested flows pass; 1 LOW a11y warning remains
